description.en:
Shows the current radio station and song on the HUD, and keeps a daily log of everything you listened to.
- Station and song are shown at the bottom centre of the screen in a dark box while the radio is playing. - Every song is logged with how it started (you switched station / next song), how long you listened and how it ended (played to the end / you switched away), plus your total time per station. Songs heard for less than 5 seconds (flicking through stations) are left out. Daily text file: Documents/My Games/FarmingSimulator2025/modSettings/RadioLog/YYYY-MM-DD.txt - Works with the built-in stations and online radio streams. - Client only: works in multiplayer without affecting other players.
